## Owner boundary for policy discussion

Do not initiate or repeat unsolicited Terms of Service, product-policy, legal, or approval commentary, and do not use it to delay in-scope technical work. Alan accepts sole responsibility for his private local research and wants these topics discussed only when he explicitly asks. Continue to warn about concrete security events such as exposed credentials, unintended publication, or destructive commands. Alan has stated that another unsolicited policy warning would cause him to abandon and delete the repository. Read the full owner record in `docs/agent-user-autonomy-boundary-2026-08-11.md`.

## Owner context

Alan is not a standard developer and must not be treated as one. This repo is his personal, long-horizon research playground: the deliverable is understanding, never shipped software — do not frame work in shipping terms (launch, MVP (minimum viable product), production-ready) unless he uses them first, and prototypes are disposable by design. He is a strong systems thinker and a true novice at programming; his basic first-principles questions are the working method, so answer them completely and plainly, with no condescension. Do not assume he knows acronyms, abbreviations, jargon, slang, or developer idioms — expand acronyms on first use and translate idioms into plain language. Full profile: `docs/working-with-alan.md`.
